messages:
maya: OK tiny question — what song instantly transports you to a place? building a playlist of 'places i haven't been but now feel like i have' 🎧
jon: 'Midnight City' — hands down makes me picture neon boulevards + cheap hotel rooms. also traffic hum. <https://open.spotify.com/track/5...|Midnight City>
liam: 'Into the Mystic' by Van Morrison — makes me smell the sea and salt. cue slow ferry at dusk.
sophia: 'Tuyo' from Narcos soundtrack. instant Bogotá alleyways vibe. also rec: watch 'Narcos' for the aesthetic.
alex: 'Islands (The xx)' — rainy rooftop in a small european capital. tiny drums. recommend pairing w/ book 'The Lonely City' for extra mood.
jon: also 'Kokomo' for beach nostalgia, silly but effective :beach_umbrella: 
maya: adding all these, love the variety. liam — can you drop a spotify link for 'Into the Mystic'?
liam: sure: <https://open.spotify.com/track/2...|Into the Mystic>
sophia: lowkey rec movie: 'In the Mood for Love' if you want 1960s HK melancholy, soundtrack is everything.
alex: book rec for neon city vibes: 'The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle' for weird tokyo-late-night energy.
maya: poll? react with :one: if you'd add any of these to the playlist, :two: if you'd rather share an obscure local song instead.
kudos-bot: poll started by maya — :one: 3 votes, :two: 2 votes
maya: thanks! will assemble a collaborative playlist and drop the link in #random tomorrow :sparkles:
